messages:
Priya (AE): Quick ask — we need a hosted API key for LumenPay POC tomorrow 10am PT. Short-lived (72h), IP-allowlist to their test subnet 203.0.113.20/29, read+generate only, token scope limited to text generation. Can SEC approve? Also need rough estimate of token costs at ~1M tokens/day so we can justify quota.

Kevin (SE): Got it. I can create a scoped, short expiry key. Two Qs: do they need streaming? and will they use embeddings? If only generation we can reduce quotas. I'll use the internal ephemeral flow so we don't store the key.

Priya (AE): Generation only (no embeddings), streaming OK but not required. They want quota cap so they don't blow demo credits.

Maria (Security): 72h ok. IP allowlist fine. We require customer-facing PII not be logged — enable request-level redact. Also need an NDA on file before enabling. KMS not required for hosted POC.

Sam (Infra): I'll create the key with scope=generate, expires=72h, quota=1.2M tokens/day, ip_allowlist="203.0.113.20/29". Creating now.

provisioning-bot: Created API key for project=lumenpay-poc, id=key_01FX... (value redacted). Expiry=72h. Remember to share via 1:1 or secure vault. :white_check_mark:

Priya (AE): Awesome — I'll schedule a short handoff with them and share the vaulted secret link. Any follow-ups re: billing or upgrade if they spike?

Kevin (SE): For spikes we can either bump quota or route to Dedicated reserved pool (sales/ECS). Pricing ballpark: $0.015/1k tokens for this POC model — estimate ~18 USD/day for 1.2M tokens. I'll DM finance for a quick confirm.

Priya (AE): Great. Also, can we rotate this key after 48h automatically? Client requested automatic rotation mid-demo.

Sam (Infra): We don't rotate hosted POC keys automatically by default, but I can provision two overlapping keys and schedule rotation via the vault. Command I used:
```
redwoodctl keys create \
  --project lumenpay-poc \
  --scopes generate \
  --expires 72h \
  --quota-tokens 1200000 \
  --ip-allowlist 203.0.113.20/29
```
I'll create key_02 as a replacement at +24h and drop the older at +72h.

Maria (Security): Ensure we annotate the ticket with the NDA and retention policy. Also flag for SOC2 team if they request export logs.

Priya (AE): Thanks all. I'll close the loop with the customer after handoff. :raised_hands:

Kevin (SE): tagging @Finance to confirm the $0.015/1k pricing for hosted POC: @Elena?

Elena (Finance): Confirmed — internal POC rate is $0.015/1k tokens for non-enterprise opt-in. If they need Dedicated, pricing differs.

Priya (AE): Perfect. I'll record the steps in the POC playbook and mark thread resolved.
